facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: loss of containment at P-3221 during a statutory inspection

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3221 and PT-3221 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-3221 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the identification of every energy source for the task was never verified as effective. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 6 March 2020 an incident occurred on P-3221 and PT-3221 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a statutory inspection, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
